entries.t: Nuzilat bi-Makkah. Awwalu surah kamilah nuzilat min al-Quran. Qala Ibn Abbas: baynama Jibril qaid inda an-nabi samia naqidan min fawqihi...
Lamma nuzilat hadhihi al-ayah shaqqa dhalika ala as-sahabah wa qalu: ayyuna la yuhaddith nafsahu? fa-qala an-nabi: aw qad wajadtum dhalik? qalu: naam. qala: dhalikum sarih al-iman.
Nuzilat fi ghazwat Uhud ba'da ma inhazam al-muslimun fa-alqa Allah alayhim an-nuas amanatan.
Nuzilat ba'da mawt Abi Talib lamma arada an-nabi an yastaghfir lahu.
Nuzilat jawaban li-l-yahud hina saalu al-mushrikin an ashab al-kahf wa ar-ruh wa dhi al-qarnayn.
Nuzilat fi Aisha radiya Allah anha fi hadithat al-ifk.
Nuzilat hina bana rasul Allah bi-Zaynab bint Jahsh.
Nuzilat fi qawm rafau aswatahum fawqa sawt an-nabi.
Nuzilat fi tahrim ma ahalla Allah lamma halafa an-nabi alla yaqraba Mariah.
Awwalu ma nuzila ala ar-rasul ba'da fatrat al-wahy.
Awwalu ayat nuzilat min al-Quran al-Karim fi Ghar Hira.
Nuzilat fi al-As ibn Wail lamma qala an an-nabiyya abtar.
Nuzilat fi Abi Lahab ibn Abd al-Muttalib.
Qala al-mushrikun li-an-nabi: insib lana rabbaka. fa-nuzilat Surat al-Ikhlas.
Nuzilat al-muawwidhatan ba'da sihr an-nabi salla Allah alayhi wa sallam.
